summary.statement: Both CMS freefunc thunks are enumerated with their exact stacks and single-release obligation. They are freefunc callbacks whose element type is a registration convention, so both are BLOCKED.

boundaries.contract: `void (*)(void *)` freefunc thunk `x509_free_void` passed to `OPENSSL_sk_pop_free`. Element-type contract: each `p` is a non-NULL, live, exclusively stack-owned `X509` (the stack's declared element type), released exactly once by `X509_free`. Registered on exactly these stacks: src/cms/cms_lib.rs:1204 (failure arm of ossl_cms_get1_certs_ex) and :1579 (test reserve/append assertions). The freefunc receives no length, count or type tag — the element type is a convention of each registration site, not a type-checked property, so the site stays BLOCKED (AGENTS.md §9 freefunc/destructor-trait rule). In the two production failure arms only elements already pushed are drained and the slot is then nulled, so there is no double release and no partially constructed element is freed.
